name.zh: 日本菊石（异形外壳复原）

scope: Original external shell only, inspired by N. mirabilis; not complete living animal or copied scan. No arms/eyes/funnel; no invisible internal septal simulation claimed.

anchors: NMNS PM35490 physical shell section photos

scale.basis: Artist nominal dimensions for display, not source specimen measurements. Aperture rim1.5–2mm and recessed cavity depth are technical art dimensions, not measured shell-wall thickness.

pose: Unsupported museum-style shell presentation in source-inspired compact orientation, aperture directed toward -Y with slightly upward lip. No soft animal, terrain or stand; not a physically resting/buoyant equilibrium claim.

surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.materials: 3–5 muted warm gray/tan values; rim/interior distinguishable under fixed neutral light, no fossil pigment claim. Preflight low-contrast material swatches in fixed four-view lighting before final detail; do not rely on black AO to explain loops.
surface_profile.detail: Closed solid tube/rim with positive wall thickness, single-sided materials. Explicit consistent triangle winding; no concave or nonplanar n-gon caps. Use clean rings/quads split deterministically with stable diagonals. Check near-self-crossings after rib relief and triangulation.

coordinates.origin: NON-GROUNDED shell object. After final evaluated geometry and all modifiers, compute world-space AABB over ALL exported mesh vertices; subtract ((xmin+xmax)/2,(ymin+ymax)/2,(zmin+zmax)/2) from geometry, bake transforms, identity root. Do not use contact footprint, center of mass or authored control-point mean. ExactGLB clean-import audit must report center residual <=1e-5m and same source bounds.

view_plan.source: Exact finalGLB clean-import fixed numeric cameras/lights/color and hash-bound manifest.
view_plan.greybox: First check growth-path continuity/loop gaps and near/far winding in all4 views; then low-contrast palette preflight, then ribs.
view_plan.extra_views: Only targeted aperture/topology diagnostic for actual ambiguity, not mandatory8.

scientific_limits: Whole external shell only. Ammonoid soft parts are largely unknown; Fig1 inferred arms/funnel excluded. No claim of full living organism anatomy.

Fig2A is CT-derived surface, Fig2B/D contain restored missing portions; Fig4E is scan rendering, not a direct fossil photograph. Fig4A-C ARE photographs of physical fossil sections. Keep these evidence types distinct.

Initial inner whorls and terminal aperture restored in study. Exact full centerline, rib count and missing terminal shape not uniquely observed; use restrained original interpretation without arbitrary knot topology.
N. mirabilis compact winding chosen; do not mix more open N. occidentalis/N. bacchus. Shell is one continuous growth tube, not linked independent toruses.

Do not model transparent internal chambers, colorful sutural frills or invented external coral spines. Rib ornament is external transverse relief; complex sutures are internal septal contacts not external raised ridges.
Hydrostatic orientation/behavior are modeled hypotheses and not certified by this visual asset. Neutral material color and aperture inner cap are art. No downloaded CT volume or mesh used.

morphology.obligation: One continuous increasing-diameter shell tube: small open planispiral inner juvenile coiling transitions into alternating three-dimensional U bends around it, ending at one larger terminal aperture. Distinct near/far loops and enclosed negative spaces, not random spaghetti, stacked donuts or flat spiral ammonite.
morphology.source: Primary Fig2A/D and Fig4E; reconstructed parts expressly acknowledged.

morphology.obligation: Rounded oval tube section with coherent transverse slightly oblique ribs following local tube direction. Selective broad lowpoly relief, not thousands of detached rings or sharp fins; taper small early end.
morphology.source: Fig4 physical sections and scanned MCM-A0435; rib amplitude simplified.

morphology.obligation: Single larger terminal opening with continuous solid rim and inward wall, recessed neutral interior closure so visible depth reads without endless black hole. No external tentacles or duplicate openings.
morphology.source: Aperture partly crushed/missing in specimens; shape and technical closed backing artistic.

acceptance_obligations: Front aperture-facing view confirms one rim and bounded cavity; side/top show nonplanar alternating U-bends, small inner coiling and near/far clearance; perspective proves tube continuity with no intersecting rib loops or disconnected toruses.
Name/metadata must say shell reconstruction, not living whole organism. Neutral inner closure not anatomical septum claim.

Generator must expose centerline checkpoints and radial profile; reject self-intersection between non-neighbor tube spans. All surfaces explicitly triangulated consistently before native/GLB comparison, no hidden n-gon ambiguity; test single-sided culling and positive rim thickness.
Report NON-GROUNDED full-final-mesh AABB center algorithm and exactGLB center residual, not footprint/support-point average. Use same evaluated vertex set for native and GLB audit.

Two complete deterministic isolated factory-startup builds/semantic digest+metrics; default asset_common/render_candidate_views helpers; dedicated EXPORT one identity asset root. Independent QA, full static8/GPU/runtime/scene acceptance separate.
production_boundary: Full static-stylized-v1 production8/GPU/scene contract is retained as reference but NOT claimed passed or imposed as current maker scope; user-requested4view model acceptance is separate.
